zh: 支持 Notebook 跨单元格查找与匹配高亮，接入 Obsidian 原生查找命令与快捷键设置
稳定代码运行期间的状态提示，增加默认开启的主题代码背景设置并修复圆角边框显示
统一 JSON 视图与 Notebook 的代码字号
优化弹窗关闭按钮、边框与滚动布局
修复环境下载时的 AbortSignal 类型错误，保留下载取消与超时处理
优化安装失败和取消后的状态恢复与重试，补充 Windows 终止安装进程的兜底
en: Find text across Notebook cells with visible match highlighting and Obsidian native find commands and hotkey settings
Keep execution status stable while running and add a theme-aware code background enabled by default, with corrected rounded borders
Use consistent code font sizes in JSON and Notebook views
Refine modal close buttons, borders, and scrolling layouts
Fix AbortSignal type errors during environment downloads while preserving cancellation and timeouts
Improve recovery and retries after failed or canceled installations, with fallback termination of Windows installer processes

zh: Markdown 编辑时就近预览光标所在的 LaTeX 公式，移到普通文字时自动隐藏
修复公式引擎加载与预览容器创建问题
修复原生 Properties 面板的中英文适配
增加 Windows、Linux、macOS 跨平台检查及原生接口兼容性回归测试
en: Preview the LaTeX formula at the cursor while editing Markdown and hide it when moving to plain text
Fix math engine initialization and preview container creation
Localize native Properties labels in Chinese and English
Add Windows, Linux, and macOS checks and native interface compatibility regression tests

zh: 插件更新后显示本版本更新摘要
大文件导出显示进度并支持取消
统一环境操作日志，合并环境检查与修复入口
已安装依赖分组显示并支持跳转到关联依赖
发布前校验版本、双语说明与发行文件
提升环境创建并发测试及更新摘要的稳定性
en: Show release notes after a plugin update
Show progress and allow cancellation for large exports
Unify environment logs and combine environment checks and repairs
Group installed dependencies and navigate to related packages
Check versions, bilingual documentation, and release assets before publishing
Improve environment creation tests and update notice reliability

zh: 支持将图片嵌入 Notebook
完善 LaTeX 公式渲染
保留 YAML 注释与格式
适配 Markdown 标题层级
增加多种导出格式
支持切换到 JSON 视图
en: Embed images in notebooks
Improve LaTeX rendering
Preserve YAML comments and formatting
Adapt Markdown heading levels
Add more export formats
Add a JSON source view
